name: Planify Quick View
description: Adds a Planify button to the GNOME top bar. Clicking it opens a quick-view card with your due-today and overdue tasks; click a task to complete it, click outside or press Escape to dismiss. Tasks are read directly (read-only) from Planify's local database, and completion is delegated to the Planify app so recurring tasks and Todoist sync stay consistent. This extension never writes to the database itself.
